# Vendored dependencies

| Crate | Version | License | Provenance |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `winit` | `0.30.13` | Apache-2.0 | Exact published crates.io package; archive SHA-256 `a6755fa58a9f8350bd1e472d4c3fcc25f824ec358933bba33306d0b63df5978d`. Windows 11 uses the OS-suggested DPI rectangle while Windows 10 retains the released adjustment; see [winit#4341](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4341) and `vendor/patches/winit/01-windows-11-dpi.md`. Wayland text input is retained across unrelated capability removal and destroyed with its seat; see [winit#4747](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4747) and `vendor/patches/winit/02-wayland-text-input.md`. Windows IME cursor lookup respects the composition flags; see [winit#4746](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4746) and `vendor/patches/winit/03-windows-ime-caret.md`. A hidden window is maximized during its first show without a transient unpainted frame; see [winit#4587](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4587) and `vendor/patches/winit/04-windows-hidden-maximized.md`. When the active X11 window's input context is replaced, the replacement is focused after queued requests; see [winit#4727](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4727) and `vendor/patches/winit/05-x11-ime-focus.md`. macOS commits follow compositions after marked text clears and preserves keyboard delivery for ordinary text; see [winit#4650](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4650), [winit#4748](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4748), and `vendor/patches/winit/06-macos-ime-commit.md`. When IME is disabled during composition, native marked text is discarded first; see [winit#4745](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4745) and `vendor/patches/winit/07-macos-ime-discard.md`. macOS text inserted outside a key press, such as emoji-picker input, is delivered as an IME commit; see [winit#4749](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4749) and `vendor/patches/winit/08-macos-emoji-picker.md`. macOS suppresses the duplicate key event when Apple Korean already committed that key through IME; see [winit#4478](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4478) and `vendor/patches/winit/09-macos-korean-space.md`. On the first Apple Korean key, one guarded compatibility-jamo callback may be retried once; see [winit#4744](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/4744) and `vendor/patches/winit/10-macos-korean-first-key.md`. |
